TSRC Corp Unveils High-Performance Elastomer for Asian Automotive Sector

Taipei – TSRC Corp, a leading Taiwan-based chemical producer, has announced the commercial launch of its latest high-performance elastomer, targeting the fast-growing automotive market in Asia. The new product, branded as SynaFlex XE, is designed to provide enhanced durability and improved processability for automotive parts manufacturers, according to the company.

The launch event, held at TSRC’s Kaohsiung technical center on Thursday, was attended by local industry representatives and regional supply chain partners. SynaFlex XE is the result of three years of research and development at TSRC’s innovation laboratories, and utilizes proprietary polymerization technology to deliver superior abrasion resistance and thermal stability.

“Increasing demand for lightweight and durable materials has driven us to introduce SynaFlex XE,” said Dr. Hsu-Chen Lin, TSRC Corp’s Chief Technology Officer. “We are confident this elastomer will help our automotive customers achieve higher efficiency and reliability in their manufacturing processes.” Lin added that the material is suitable for a range of applications, including seals, hoses, and vibration-damping components.

Industry analysts welcomed the announcement, citing the region’s robust vehicle production and the push for higher performance standards. “The Asian automotive sector is placing greater emphasis on advanced materials to meet stringent regulatory and consumer requirements,” commented Mei-Ling Wu, materials analyst at Pacific Horizons Consulting.

TSRC Corp reported that initial production of SynaFlex XE will be based at its Tainan facility, with plans to scale up output depending on customer uptake. The company is also collaborating with Taiwanese auto parts manufacturers such as Han-Dex Industries to integrate the new elastomer into upcoming vehicle platforms.
